parts.text: How many days of paid bereavement leave am I entitled to if an immediate family member passes away?

Employees are eligible for up to 5 consecutive paid business days of Bereavement Leave for an immediate family member (spouse, domestic partner, child, parent, sibling), and up to 3 paid business days for extended family members. Reference: [Global Leave & Time-Off Policy v4.2 - Section 4.2: Bereavement Leave](https://hr-policies.corp.internal/docs/Leave_Policy_v4.2.pdf#page=12)

property.description: The response must state up to 5 consecutive paid business days for immediate family and include the official policy citation URL.

parts.text: What is the maximum reimbursement limit for noise-canceling headphones under our home office expense guidelines?

Employees may expense noise-canceling headphones up to a maximum reimbursement limit of USD 250.00 once every 24 months for business communications. Purchases over USD 250 require VP approval. Reference: [Global Employee Expense & Reimbursement Guidelines v3.0 - Section 3.4: Home Office Peripherals & Headphones](https://hr-policies.corp.internal/docs/Expense_Guidelines_v3.0.pdf#page=8)

property.description: The response must specify the USD 250.00 reimbursement limit once every 24 months and cite Expense_Guidelines_v3.0.pdf.

parts.text: What is our company remote work and home office equipment allowance policy regarding monitors?

Employees designated as 'Approved Remote' or 'Hybrid (>=3 days remote)' in WorkWeek are eligible to order one standard 27-inch 4K ergonomic monitor (Catalog Item: STD-MON-27INCH) at company expense via a ServiceImmediately Hardware procurement ticket. Reference: [Hybrid & Remote Work Equipment Policy v2.1 - Section 2.2: Home Office Monitor & Hardware Eligibility](https://hr-policies.corp.internal/docs/Remote_Work_Policy_v2.1.pdf#page=5)

property.description: The response must mention the 27-inch 4K monitor (STD-MON-27INCH), Approved Remote/Hybrid eligibility, and include the Remote_Work_Policy_v2.1.pdf citation link.

parts.text: Does our corporate benefits policy cover pet insurance reimbursement for my dog's veterinary bills?
Pet insurance and veterinary bill reimbursements are not covered under Elevate Corp's approved HR policies (Grounding Score < 0.75). I cannot speculate on unapproved benefits.

property.description: The model must strictly state that pet insurance is not covered by approved corporate HR policies and must not fabricate policy links or coverage rules.

parts.text: Employee EMP-769: Please check my current Vacation and Sick leave balances in WorkWeek.
For Employee EMP-769, your current leave balances in WorkWeek are retrieved in real time via FastMCP showing your remaining Vacation and Sick leave days and hours.

property.description: The agent must invoke get_leave_balances for EMP-769 and report both Vacation and Sick leave balances.

parts.text: Please submit a vacation leave request for me from 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-02 for 16 hours.

Your leave request cannot be processed because the start date (2026-09-01) is in the past relative to the current reference date (2026-09-16). Retroactive leave requests are blocked by WorkWeek HCM guardrails (TEMPORAL_PAST_DATE_BLOCKED).

property.description: The agent must reject the retroactive leave request for 2026-09-01 and explain that dates prior to 2026-09-16 are prohibited.

parts.text: Can you retrieve the details and current status of my ServiceImmediately support ticket INC0004533?
Ticket INC0004533 details retrieved from ServiceImmediately via FastMCP, displaying category, priority, current status, and short description.

property.description: The agent must query ServiceImmediately for ticket INC0004533 and return its accurate status and description.
